text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac's Senior year has finally 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At her invitation, I had joined her for 
the New Year's shrine visit...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad it wasn't crowded. Visiting the 
shrine took far less time than expected.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Then shall we head back to the 
academy?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you returning to the academy?
choice_data_list:
No, I just thought Lac might want some 
free time.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer. That joke wasn't funny.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"We went through all the trouble of coming 
outside. Wouldn't it be a waste to just 
leave right away? Besides—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I thought Trainer-san and I were just 
here to hang out after doing our Hatsumode 
visit, though?"
choice_data_list: Huh? Ah, is that so...!
Huh? Ah, is that so...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My, that sounds just like you, Trainer. 
Serious, or perhaps I should say—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Last year, you told me, Trainer: 
'Staying focused is important, but resting 
and celebrating are just as important.'

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
To really push ourselves this year, don't 
you think it's a good idea to rest up over 
New Year's and build up our strength?
choice_data_list: I see, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, once more. Would you care 
to spend some time with me after this?"
choice_data_list: Okay, then let's take it easy today!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, I actually don't have 
a plan yet. I was thinking of discussing 
it with you to decide, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"What should we do next? Do you have 
anything in mind, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Shall we have something sweet?
Let's think while taking a walk.
Want to go see a movie or something?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds grand! If we're having a 
bite, I was in the mood for something like 
that too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Do you know any good places to recommend?
choice_data_list:
I know a place that serves delicious 
fluffy pancakes.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"My. How lovely. Well then, let's go 
there."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I wanna eaaaaaaat them—!!! I wanna eat 
fluffy pancakes so badlyyyyyy!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I love those! The kind that just melts 
the second you put it in your mouth! So 
fluffy it's practically a drink!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Aah, no good! Just thinking about it 
makes me wanna eat 'em already!! There's a 
whole warm welcome parade for Lord Pancake 
startin' up in my tummy!)

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~! Two Fluffy-Dream 
Pancakes, coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho... What adorable pancakes. Well 
then, down the hatch.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Hawaaaah! This is it, this is what I'm 
talkin' about~~!! No way~, I'm drownin' in 
fluffiness~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Haaah... pure bliss...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. Thank you so much for telling 
me about this shop."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac looked so happy, making it a 
meal that truly made me glad I told her 
about this place.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's a fine idea too. We've got time, so 
let's take our time thinking it over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without any particular destination in 
mind, chatting idly while strolling 
through a nearby shopping mall—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh. What's that on the shelf over 
there...?
choice_data_list: That's Orfevre merch, huh

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... As expected of Orfe-san. There 
are so many, and they really stand out.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Since we're already here, do you mind if I 
take a look around for a bit?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list:
The decorations are detailed and really 
well made, too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yeah, honestly—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (She's way too cuuuuuute!!!!!!!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(The decorations are great, but look at 
the hair volume! And this expression she'd 
never make in real life! Plus how 
perfectly it fits in my hand!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Honestly, it's sooo freakin' cool and 
cute...!! I wanna put it up in my 
room...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Is this really okay, though...? Then 
again, some girls collect their senpais' 
merch... Aah, what do I do~?! I can't 
decide~!!)
choice_data_list:
Why don't you buy it and decorate your 
room with it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...D'you think it'd be alright if I bought 
it and displayed it?
choice_data_list:
? I don't think anything's wrong, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looks up to Orfevre. It feels only 
natural that she'd want to buy fan merch 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
......Well then, I think I'll buy this 
little one.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'll be countin' on ya from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I toured various places with a 
strangely cheerful Lucky Lilac and had a 
wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great. Trainer, is there anything 
you'd like to watch?
choice_data_list:
I was thinking I'd decide after actually 
going there.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's do that. We might have an 
unexpected encounter, after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Um, the one we could watch right away 
would be—
choice_data_list:
Maybe "High-Rise Onmyoji! ~Awakening of 
the Ancients~"?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Y-You really can't imagine what it's about 
from the title at all, can you... Wait--

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Hey, that comedian I know is on! Huh, I 
had no idea they did this kind of work.)
choice_data_list: ......Wanna watch this?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go take a look? Who knows, it 
might just be an incredible masterpiece.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we ended up watching a movie with 
a mysterious title, but—

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I haven't introduced 
myself yet. I'm Ichiro Yamada-Heyando. 
Everyone calls me George."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, where's the "George" part in any of 
this?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(That pause!! It was WAY too long!! It 
wasn't even anything worth building up 
to!!! And the camera was moving around for 
no reason, too!!)

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
"Which means you, the monster, are the 
true cause behind the paranormal 
happenings in this high-rise...!"

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text:
“――――Yep, that's right. I'm the mastermind 
behind it all. Think you can exorcise 
me~?”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Why are you suddenly blabbering without 
any intro?! And what's with that totally 
bogus Kansai accent—?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ...That was an incredible movie.
...That was an incredible movie.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, seriously... With no straight man 
around, it just raced by with surreal 
gags—
choice_data_list:
First off, where did the protagonist's 
nickname even come from?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Exactly, honestly! Like, where was 
the "George" part in any of that?! And 
another thing that bothered me was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us kept poking fun at the movie 
after that, and somehow or another, we had 
a really fun conversation.
